```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert the date column to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a histogram of dog ages
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterV10Sort'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
plt.xlabel('Age (Years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
